name: lead-machine
description: Open-source, self-hosted lead generation CRM for freelancers & small agencies. Find businesses on OpenStreetMap, score leads, manage contacts, quotes & invoices — with optional AI help, for €0 in subscriptions. 7 languages, MIT license.

paragraphs: 👨‍💻 An Ahsen-Studio Creation The perfect blend of human vision and AI execution. Idea & Vision: Ahsen Kurtoski (teenager developer & visionary) AI Execution: Built flawlessly by Artificial Intelligence

Freelancers and small web agencies waste dozens of hours per year on subscription tools just to find, contact, and follow up with local prospects. The typical stack costs €50–€200/mo and locks your data inside a SaaS.
features: ✅ Free forever (MIT license). No paid tiers, no "pro upgrade" walls.
✅ Your data stays yours — a single prisma/dev.db SQLite file, portable to any machine.
✅ 100% offline-friendly (except when calling the optional AI providers or the live Overpass / OSM APIs).
✅ Made for humans: modern, responsive UI with dark mode, 7 interface languages, and WCAG 2.1 AA-aware accessibility.

Geographic search: query OpenStreetMap (Overpass) by category + radius + city, with automatic failover across public mirrors. Optional second source: Geoapify (free tier) — results from both sources are merged and…
